description: Lane 0 reproduction wrapper for the published fx2-cmix Hutter Prize package path. This candidate is intentionally separate from experimental fx2 and cmix21 lanes: it exercises the upstream cmix -e flow that emits archive9, then executes archive9 to restore enwik9.
scope: Full enwik9 only. The upstream -e/archive9 path uses fixed enwik9 split and article-order constants, so prefix gates are not a valid reproduction of the public package path.
prepare: Use projects/enwiki9/tools/fx2_public_repro_queue.py --preflight, then --build-upstream to attempt the exact upstream build_and_construct_comp.sh flow. After projects/enwiki9/external/fx2-cmix/run/cmix exists, run --prepare. If the exact upstream package is absent, --prepare-from-root-binary can assemble a local public-flow control package from projects/enwiki9/external/fx2-cmix/cmix, but that is not an exact public executable-size reproduction unless its package size matches the upstream target.
verdict: Not run. This lane exists to reproduce the published fx2-cmix baseline and validate local data, accounting, RSS guard, and result parsing before trusting full-corpus experimental claims.
